report.summary: Patient P-D001 (Raymond Ellis, DOB 1968-03-14, ESRD/diabetes/CKD) screens positive for food insecurity ("food worry sometimes true"). Coverage is dual Medicaid/Medicare (Lakeshore Community Health Plan) with a transport benefit. Home tract 17031260300. Four food-access options identified; a medically tailored meals referral (dual-eligible, ESRD/diabetes appropriate) was submitted via the portal form and is pending contact within one business day. Pantry/fridge options have no or minimal eligibility barriers (Cook County residency for Saturday Market Pantry; no ID for Northwest Side Food Pantry; open-access community fridge).

options.name: Medically tailored meals referral
options.how_to_access: Referral form submitted (patient name, DOB, address, diagnoses); program will respond within one business day. Appropriate given dual coverage + ESRD/diabetes/CKD diagnoses.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12–3 PM, no ID required; fresh produce Wednesdays.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM–noon; Cook County residents only.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM–8 PM; take what you need, no eligibility requirements.

fields.diagnoses: End stage renal disease (N18.6), Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease (E11.22), Hypertensive CKD with stage 5 CKD or ESRD (I12.0), Dependence on renal dialysis (Z99.2)
